```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {createOCP, step, temperature, linearProfile} from "./ocp.js"
blue = "#0072B2"
orange = "#B55000"
ink = "#17202A"
muted = "#526175"
grid = "#E3E7EB"
W = 970
H = 500
// One simulation for the lifetime of the page; the slider only sets the bath.
sim = createOCP({L: 4, Lambda: 100, grid: 32, kappa: 0.2})
reference = linearProfile(sim, Tbath)
// Electron density in the slab |z| < 1/2, averaged over ~130 frames and lightly
// blurred: thermal motion moves each electron about lambda_D per frame, so the
// time-averaged cloud is calm where single electrons only flicker.
G = 32
density = ({avg: null, img: (() => { const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = G; c.height = G; return c; })()})
```

```{ojs}
canvas = {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  const dpr = Math.min(3, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  c.width = W * dpr; c.height = H * dpr;
  c.style.width = "100%"; c.style.display = "block";
  c.getContext("2d").scale(dpr, dpr);
  return c;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Text with "_x" subscripts, drawn in the slide face.
label = (ctx, s, x, y, {size = 19, color = ink, align = "left"} = {}) => {
  const parts = s.split(/(_\{[^}]*\}|_\S)/).filter(Boolean);
  const font = (z) => `${z}px 'STIX Two Text', serif`;
  const width = parts.reduce((w, p) => { ctx.font = font(p[0] === "_" ? 0.72 * size : size);
    return w + ctx.measureText(p.replace(/^_\{?|\}$/g, "")).width; }, 0);
  let cx = align === "right" ? x - width : align === "center" ? x - width / 2 : x;
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  for (const p of parts) {
    const sub = p[0] === "_", t = p.replace(/^_\{?|\}$/g, "");
    ctx.font = font(sub ? 0.72 * size : size);
    ctx.fillText(t, cx, y + (sub ? 0.25 * size : 0));
    cx += ctx.measureText(t).width;
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
draw = (T) => {
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d"), L = sim.L;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // Left: electrons of the slab |z| < 1/2 around the test charge, seen along z.
  const S = 440, ox = 14, oy = 14, s = S / L;
  ctx.strokeStyle = grid; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(ox, oy, S, S);
  const [X, Y, Z] = sim.pos;
  const counts = new Float64Array(G * G);
  let inside = 0;
  for (let p = 0; p < sim.N; p++) {
    if (Math.abs(Z[p]) > 0.5) continue;
    const i = Math.min(G - 1, Math.floor((X[p] / L + 0.5) * G));
    const j = Math.min(G - 1, Math.floor((0.5 - Y[p] / L) * G));
    counts[j * G + i] += 1; inside += 1;
  }
  const mean = inside / (G * G);
  if (!density.avg) density.avg = Float64Array.from(counts, (c) => mean);
  for (let k = 0; k < G * G; k++) density.avg[k] += 0.015 * (counts[k] - density.avg[k]);
  const img = density.img.getContext("2d"), data = img.createImageData(G, G);
  for (let j = 0; j < G; j++) for (let i = 0; i < G; i++) {
    let sum = 0, wsum = 0;
    for (let dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
      const w = (di ? 1 : 2) * (dj ? 1 : 2);
      sum += w * density.avg[((j + dj + G) % G) * G + (i + di + G) % G]; wsum += w;
    }
    const ratio = sum / wsum / mean, q = 4 * (j * G + i);
    // n_e / n_0 = 0.4 white, 1 mid blue, 1.4 full blue: the hole stands out
    data.data[q] = 0; data.data[q + 1] = 114; data.data[q + 2] = 178;
    data.data[q + 3] = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (ratio - 0.4) / 1.0)) * 0.9);
  }
  img.putImageData(data, 0, 0);
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
  ctx.drawImage(density.img, ox, oy, S, S);
  if (dots) {
    ctx.fillStyle = blue;
    for (let p = 0; p < sim.N; p++) {
      const z = Math.abs(Z[p]);
      if (z > 0.5) continue;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (0.5 - z) / 0.1);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox + (X[p] + L / 2) * s, oy + (L / 2 - Y[p]) * s, 2.2, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  const cx = ox + S / 2, cy = oy + S / 2, lambda = Math.sqrt(T);
  ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]); ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, lambda * s, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
  label(ctx, "λ_D", cx + lambda * s * 0.72 + 6, cy - lambda * s * 0.72 - 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = orange; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
  label(ctx, `t ω_p = ${sim.time.toFixed(0)}`, ox + S, oy + S + 26, {size: 17, color: muted, align: "right"});

  // Right: time-averaged density deficit in shells against linear response.
  const x0 = 560, x1 = 950, y0 = 44, y1 = 430, rmax = L / 2, ymin = -0.5, ymax = 4;
  const px = (r) => x0 + r / rmax * (x1 - x0), py = (v) => y1 - (v - ymin) / (ymax - ymin) * (y1 - y0);
  ctx.strokeStyle = grid; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (const v of [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, py(v)); ctx.lineTo(x1, py(v)); ctx.stroke();
    label(ctx, String(v), x0 - 8, py(v) + 6, {size: 17, align: "right"}); }
  for (const r of [0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2]) label(ctx, String(r), px(r), y1 + 24, {size: 17, align: "center"});
  ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x0, y1); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.stroke();
  label(ctx, "r / λ_{D0} [1]", x1, y1 + 50, {size: 17, align: "right"});
  label(ctx, "−δn_e / (κ n_0) [1]", x0 - 40, y0 - 22, {size: 17});
  ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0); ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = orange; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.setLineDash([8, 5]); ctx.beginPath();
  sim.radii.forEach((r, b) => { const v = -reference[b] / sim.kappa; b ? ctx.lineTo(px(r), py(v)) : ctx.moveTo(px(r), py(v)); });
  ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
  if (sim.averaged) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = blue; ctx.fillStyle = blue; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.beginPath();
    sim.radii.forEach((r, b) => { const v = -sim.averaged[b] / sim.kappa; b ? ctx.lineTo(px(r), py(v)) : ctx.moveTo(px(r), py(v)); });
    ctx.stroke();
    sim.radii.forEach((r, b) => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px(r), py(-sim.averaged[b] / sim.kappa), 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill(); });
  }
  ctx.restore();
  label(ctx, "particles", x1 - 4, py(3.5), {color: blue, align: "right"});
  label(ctx, "linear response", x1 - 4, py(3.0), {color: orange, align: "right"});
  label(ctx, `k_B T_e / k_B T_0 = ${temperature(sim).toFixed(2)}`, x0 + 14, py(-0.25), {size: 17, color: muted});
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Runs once per animation frame while the page is shown (browsers pause it in
// hidden frames); a new bath temperature only replaces this loop, not the plasma.
loop = {
  while (true) {
    step(sim, Tbath, 0.1, 30);
    draw(Tbath);
    yield sim.time;
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof Tbath = Inputs.range([0.25, 4], {value: 1, transform: Math.log, step: 0.01,
  label: html`<i>k</i><sub>B</sub><i>T</i><sub>bath</sub> / <i>k</i><sub>B</sub><i>T</i><sub>0</sub>`})
```

```{ojs}
viewof dots = Inputs.toggle({label: "particles", value: false})
```

//| output: false
{
  const div = viewof Tbath.querySelector("div");

  out.textContent = Tbath.toFixed(2);
}
